text: I usually start conversations with people I don't know well.
I prefer to have a wide circle of friends rather than a few close ones.
After a long week of school, I prefer to stay home alone to recharge.
I feel uncomfortable being the center of attention.
I think fast and like to 'speak while I think'.
I trust facts and experience more than theories and 'what ifs'.
I often get lost in my thoughts and imagine the future.
I prefer classes that teach practical skills I can use immediately.
I like to understand the 'big picture' before learning the details.
I pay close attention to details and rarely make careless mistakes.
When making a decision, I follow my head (logic) more than my heart.
I worry a lot about hurting other people's feelings.
It is more important to be truthful than to be tactful (polite).
I naturally understand how people are feeling emotionally.
I value justice and fairness over mercy and forgiveness.
I like to have a schedule and stick to it.
I work better under pressure, right before the deadline.
I dislike surprises and prefer to know what will happen next.
I am messy and disorganized, but I know where everything is.
I like to finish my work well before the deadline so I can relax.
